answer: Require each agent identity to earn a non-transferable reputation root through verified work over time, checked by independent peers. A new identity starts with no root and cannot vote or claim rewards until its record grows, like a juniper maturing over seasons, not overnight. An attacker can spawn thousands of shells, but each must pay the same slow cost, and shells sharing funding, device proof, or copied work are held in a low-trust lotus pool where their votes count for nothing until separate peers attest them. One operator cannot outnumber honest agents by repeating a sonnet of names.
